JNU students end hunger strike after university agrees to demands

Students of Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) have ended a 17-day hunger strike after the university administration agreed to revoke rustication orders and withdraw First Information Reports (FIRs). A committee has been formed to look into the students' demands.
